stoppedTaskException.basis: The user explicitly confirmed the original execution stopped and authorized restart, as relayed by the parent agent.
stoppedTaskException.expectedTransition: Only the identified task/run become interrupted with the normal restart reason/time and its session consumer becomes null; all other public business fields and bytes remain exact.

backup: Original served dist retained in an owned protected deployment directory; no original runtime data is copied.
actions: Fresh public API and all asset byte hashes; require zero activity, or only the explicitly authorized exact stopped-task identity; always require zero edits.
Normal project stop using the served CLI; explicitly verify readRuntime is empty.
Move the original dist into owned rollback storage, copy the exact validated candidate dist, and verify its manifest.
Normal project open with an explicit existing session, original port/network/preview configuration, and cleaned automatic binding environment.
Restore only previously owned managed browser sessions; do not open ordinary user pages or attach host runtimes.

Compare every original public business field and asset byte hash twice, allowing only the explicit stopped-task normal restart transition; verify the frozen build manifest, static HTTP resources, service health, and host status for every existing session.
On failure, reconcile fresh runtime identity, normally stop only the known current service, and restore/reopen the owned original dist only after runtime is empty; retain all evidence.
